title: AI Data Leakage Prevention and Detection (FINOS AIGF mi-1)

egress-audit.description: Log and retain audit of data categories leaving the trust boundary

forbid-unapproved-callers.description: Only approved application components may call the hosted model API

edge-type.description: Class of architectural edge this control instance applies to

purpose.description: Approved business purpose for this egress

session-data-classification.description: Data classifications that may cross this boundary when authorized

allowed-egress-categories.description: Categories of data permitted to leave toward the hosted model

forbidden-egress-categories.description: Categories of data that must never leave toward the hosted model on this path
